217070.description:
The second cour of Futsutsuka na Akujo de wa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den.

Through the actions of Reirin and Keigetsu, the series of disturbances caused by a curse in the inner court have settled down.
Through their swap, Reirin and Keigetsu learned of each other’s character, and a friendship was budding between the two of them.

Seasons pass, and we are now at early autumn. The location of the ritual where the Crown Prince and the Maidens wish for a bountiful harvest (the Harvest Festival) has been set within the southern lands ruled by the Shu clan. With no consort as guardian, Keigetsu arduously continues with preparations despite feeling the pressure as the host of the Harvest Festival. Meanwhile, Reirin is wholeheartedly supporting Keigetsu while being thrilled about her first royal outing.

However, right upon arrival, an unforeseen accident occurs and the ritual is interrupted. An agitated Keigetsu’s spell runs out of control, and she once again swaps bodies with Reirin. On top of that, among all the confusion, the post-swap Reirin is abducted...!?

Reirin’s two overprotective brothers Kou Keikou and Kou Keishou get involved and the situation heads in an unexpected direction.
Who is the new mastermind who is sneaking up in order to frame Keigetsu...?

The gratifying tale of switched fates brought to you by two girls who are polar opposites—the curtain rises on the second act, "The First Royal Outing" Arc!

(Source: Official Site)

217009.description:
Based on the erotic game by Jitaku Studio.

Hatsune Nijo’s tastes were thoroughly warped by the influence of a childhood friend’s mother, leaving him with an intense obsession with gyaru (gal) fashion and culture. Years later, Hatsune’s fixation had only deepened—to the point where he began cross-dressing to embody his ideal gyaru persona himself. Then, one day, he received a message from his younger sister, Tsukune Nijo: "Hey, Big Bro! So, my school recently started allowing students to wear casual clothes..." "If you're still into that whole 'gal' thing, why not come to school with me?" There was no curing this twisted obsession of his. So, he decided to simply embrace it and live life on his own terms! With that resolve, Hatsune returned to his hometown and decided to transfer into the school. A new school life begins—one spent alongside gyaru girls who fully accept and celebrate his cross-dressing alter ego!

(Source: Pinkpineapple, translated)

217714.description:
They used to be sworn enemies. Now they’re sworn spouses.

Roshi Saigawa and Ritsuka Nagira were once bitter rivals, each fighting for supremacy within rival organizations of superpowered warriors. Their days were filled with duels, schemes, and a rivalry so fierce it seemed nothing could ever bridge the gap between them. Yet, somehow, the impossible has happened— they’re now happily married!

From bitter enemies to star-crossed lovers, these two have traded their weapons for wedding vows, and their former battles have given way to laughter, love, and the everyday chaos of newlywed life.

But just because they’ve left the battlefield behind doesn’t mean life has gotten easier. Old rivalries resurface, secrets linger, and the lines between love, rivalry, and sheer chaos blur in ways neither of them expected. From laugh-out-loud domestic disasters to heart-melting romantic moments, Roshi and Ritsuka are about to prove that falling in love with your enemy isn’t just possible— it’ s explosive.

Full of humor, heart, and sizzling chemistry, this enemies-to-lovers rom-com will keep you laughing, swooning, and turning pages until the very last!

(Source: One Peace Books)

217717.description:
Our world is actually falling apart, unbeknownst to most. A bizarre apparatus hiding in the depths of Ueno's Shinobazu Pond, a giant snail clinging onto the Eiffel Tower, a demon lord in the form of a beautiful girl... these and countless other cryptic entities—called "Ends"—are driving us closer to the apocalypse. However, some youngsters decided to reject that fate and secretly took up arms.

They are fighting, not to stop the countdown or to eradicate the threats, but only to delay the inevitable. Why would they choose such a thorny path on their own volition? To make the most out of their youth in this godforsaken world! I, a former cartel slave (and ESPer), have had a pretty shit life so far, to be honest. But maybe here I'll be able to lead a fulfilling school life, at least?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
